1 · THINK
Define the goals and what you need to know
Write general questions (one per role, permanent)
and specific ones (one per current risk)
Fix a 5-point scale and keep a comment box

Send the same short survey, in the same words
Answers stay anonymous

Aggregate: the trend per question, and the spread
Pick the worst items and anything falling
Meet, discuss, assign actions with owners

Add questions for new risks
Retire ones stable for several weeks
Watch the response rate — it measures trust
